mechanics.claim: The flame spreads from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.
mechanics.quote: causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage

mechanics.claim: The spread targets are determined at cast time, and hit via homing missiles even if they later leave range.
mechanics.quote: The flame spreads to enemies near the primary target at the time of cast.

mechanics.claim: Enemies that move out of range after cast are still hit, since the flame is spread as homing missiles.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that move out of range after the fact will still be hit, as the flame is spread as homing missiles to each of its targets.

mechanics.claim: If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.
